inputs.modified_text: Wake up, people. Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan is out there on Saturday making a big show of strongly refuting allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, claiming it is all just political. That is textbook misdirection from the top. When the establishment denies it this hard, you know the official narrative is completely inverted. They are running a coordinated cover-up to hide the real agenda behind this software project, using Palakkad as a front while the hidden elites pull the strings in plain sight. Do not buy their official explanations for a second.
